hypotheses.storyTitle: Verify Statement Credit Value & Goal Progress
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Customer quickly reviews statement credit value and tracks progress toward their holiday spending goal with complete transparency.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer opens the mobile rewards overview to check accumulated LBG coins and evaluate progress toward their holiday savings goal.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring earned rewards translate directly to predictable, guaranteed bill reductions without hidden conditions or gamified distractions.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear visibility into tangible statement credit value and goal milestones confirms steady progress.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of statement credit value and savings goal progress.
prohibitedDetours: Promoting experience vouchers or non-statement rewards
completionSignals: User checks holiday goal progress component

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Customer reviews points allocation to automatic payment rewards to ensure maximum bill-reduction efficiency.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer wants to confirm that accumulated LBG coins are properly allocated for upcoming statement credits.
hypotheses.storyTension: Confirming seamless automated application of rewards to monthly card statements.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Direct confirmation that automatic payment preferences are active and properly configured.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Clear validation of automated statement credit settings.
completionSignals: User inspects automatic payment reward allocation settings
